team_history.note: Drafted No. 4 overall by Titans in 2026 NFL Draft; college: Ohio State

workload.note: No verified 2025 college season total found (only preseason projection was fetched, which predicted 1,000 yards/10 TD as OSU's WR2 replacing Emeka Egbuka). 2024 college: 52 rec, 733 yds, 4 TD.

contract.note: Signed fully-guaranteed 4-year, $51.1M rookie deal with $33.6M signing bonus after being drafted No. 4 overall.

scheme.note: Titans hired Daboll (former Giants HC) as OC for 2026; new HC is Robert Saleh (hired Jan 2026). QB is Cam Ward (2nd-year).

competition.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
competition.note: Signed 4-yr/$78M with TEN Mar 12, 2026, reuniting with former Giants HC Daboll; posted first 1,000-yd season in 2025 with NYG after Malik Nabers' Week 4 ACL tear.

competition.name: Calvin Ridley
competition.note: Fractured fibula ended his 2025 season after 7 games (17 rec, 303 yds); Titans restructured his deal Mar 16, 2026, cutting cap hit by $11M with incentives to recoup pay.

competition.name: Elic Ayomanor
competition.note: Listed directly behind starters on Aug 8, 2026 unofficial depth chart.

competition.name: Chimere Dike
competition.note: Listed on Titans depth chart behind starters.

notes: Aug 8, 2026 unofficial Titans depth chart: Tate listed as a starting WR alongside Calvin Ridley and Wan'Dale Robinson in 3-WR set (tennesseetitans.com).

Beat writer Justin Melo (SI/OnSI, undated summer 2026 piece) reported Tate and Cam Ward showed 'terrific chemistry' in offseason workouts, including 3 TD connections at the team's first open practice.
Projected as Week 1 starter / immediate impact with ~70% snap share per Footballguys draft-day analysis (April 2026, pre-camp).
At Ohio State, Tate played alongside Jeremiah Smith and Emeka Egbuka and was never the primary/No.1 receiver in college.

camp.quote: Tate is listed as a starter in the Titans' 3-WR set alongside Calvin Ridley and Wan'Dale Robinson.
Tate and Ward already displayed terrific chemistry during offseason workouts, including connecting for three touchdowns at the team's first open practice.
